identity.description: Stripe is a payments and financial infrastructure platform whose public REST API (api.stripe.com) covers payments, billing, Connect, Issuing, Treasury, tax and Radar.
identity.identity_notes: Docs at docs.stripe.com describe the Stripe API and Stripe MCP server directly. Confirmed as the Stripe payments platform named in the task.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth2 authorization code flow for Stripe Connect (GET https://connect.stripe.com/oauth/authorize, POST https://connect.stripe.com/oauth/token) and for the Stripe MCP server's OAuth consent flow. Standard API keys are not OAuth.
auth.token_refresh: Connect OAuth: refresh_token grant returns new access token. MCP OAuth refresh tokens expire after 14 days. Workload Identity Federation yields a Stripe access token that expires after 1 hour. Static secret keys do not expire.
auth.scopes_notes: Secret keys: sk_test_ (unrestricted in sandbox) and sk_live_ (full access to all resources). Restricted keys (rk_live_) carry per-resource permissions. Connect OAuth scope is read_write or read_only; read_only only for registered extensions. Agent API keys exist for MCP.

access.production_restrictions: Live mode is the gated part: live keys carry real-money access, Connect platforms need platform setup, and from 2027-01-11 Stripe MCP stops accepting full-access secret keys and non-agent restricted keys. Live-account verification and fees were not verified from official pages.

read_ops: List/retrieve customers, charges, payment intents, setup intents, payment methods, checkout sessions, invoices, subscriptions, products, prices, refunds, disputes, payouts, balance transactions, events, webhook endpoints
write_ops: Create/update customers, invoices, invoice items, subscriptions, products, prices, coupons, payment links, payment method domains, tax registrations; create refunds; cancel and void; update disputes; create webhook endpoints and event destinations
api.rate_limits: Live mode global 100 requests per second; sandbox global 25 requests per second; individual endpoints 25 requests per second unless noted. Exceeding returns 429 Too Many Requests. Concurrency limit default 50 in-progress requests in live mode.
api.limitations: API does not support bulk updates (one object per request). Limits vary by endpoint (PaymentIntents 1000 updates per object per hour, Subscriptions invoice caps). Read requests have a rolling allocation of 500 per transaction, minimum 10,000 per month. Sandbox limits are lower than live. Some v2 APIs are preview-only.
